question: What is the characteristic of a small-scale industry?

options.text: It should be supportive to the agricultural sector.
It is generally a labour-intensive unit.
It should be a subsidiary of large industry
It should be established in rural area only.

solution:
The correct answer is **"It is generally a labor-intensive unit".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Small-scale industries:**

 
 
• **Industries** in which manufacturing, production, and servicing of goods are done on a small scale.
 
• The total investment of these types of industries **does not exceed over 1 crore.**
 
• Small-scale industries have **single ownership**.
 
• These industries are **labor intensive **so there is only limited use of technology.
 
• These work in local areas and fulfill the demands of locals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Large-scale industries:**

 
 
• **​​**have a huge infrastructure, and raw materials and require large numbers of workers.
 
• The capital requirement is also large and industries that have fixed assets of **more than 10 crores **are considered large-scale industries.
 
• There are several large-scale industries in India like **Iron and steel, automobile, textile, silk industry,** etc.
 
• These industries use the latest technology and machines.
 
• Their contribution to the country's economy is also huge.
 
• These require skilled workers that **provide employment**.
